title: JPL/NASA Shuttle Alternate Propellant Program Phase I - 70-lb BATES motor firings

capability_notes.VA: Theoretical values from JPL's unnamed free-energy-minimisation program (Table 2-2) are held as an imported reference case; the binders have no formula or enthalpy.
capability_notes.VB: Crawford-bomb strands the source flags as possibly biased by RAM-225 mold release; the stated modified-baseline law prints no units beside the equation; per-firing rates are in the BATES tables.
capability_notes.VC: Integral quantities and endpoints are rich, but no Pc(t) and no BATES grain dimensions in this report; standard BATES dimensions from other sources were NOT verified.
capability_notes.VD: Measured c*, Isp, It per firing - for delivered-performance comparison only, never against ideal CEA Isp as an error.

propellant.source_name: TP-H1148, current baseline (Table 2-1, footnote a: also to be adjusted)

fraction.note: Footnote b: Fe2O3 to be adjusted.
PBAN is cured with epoxy Der-331; that the percentage includes the curative is an R1 inference from the footnotes, not stated.

density.note: Density was not audited in R1.

initial_temperature.note: No grain temperature was audited in R1.

blockers: No binder formula or enthalpy (PBAN with epoxy; HTPB with IPDI).
The AN-based candidates use trade-name ballistic modifiers (AD, CU-0202 P).
HMX, in three candidates, is absent from the installed thermo.lib.
notes: Table 2-1 also lists five AN-based candidates (AN-25, AN-71, ANH-12, ANH-33, ANH-18); schema version 1 carries one formulation per record, so they are cited, not carried. BATES per-firing data (Tables 3-x, e.g. run E-1453 on PDF pp.82-84) are cited, not carried: firing data belong to later evidence work; Pc(t) appears only in photographs (Figures 3-1 to 3-3) and the grain's outside diameter, length and segment count are not in this report. Printed inconsistencies are preserved, not corrected: Table 2-2 prints the TP-H1148 c* with disagreeing SI and ft/s values (recorded verbatim in comparison case jpl-79-29-tp-h1148-theoretical), and Table 3-21 prints run E-1455's integral of F dt with a decimal placement inconsistent with run E-1453's. Ingredient labels follow the R1 transcription of the source table; they are not a verbatim copy of its row headings.
